step.cmd: Determine if the client was reached during fact-finding or if the client replied to the N-10-00-00 letter:

ul.li: If the client was reached, go to step 6.
If the client was not reached or did not reply to the E-02-00-00 email or the N-10-00-00 letter and a decision can be rendered based on the facts on file, go to step 7.

If the client was not reached or did not reply to the E-02-00-00 email or the N-10-00-00 letter and a decision cannot be rendered based on the facts on file, go to Missing information . Missing information

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Details: Document any additional information according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
